{{Quote|If we can get safely through the Starswarm Cluster, the Navagator's ''[sic]'' Guild will pay us a fortune!|Jori Daragon, to her brother Gav|<ref name="TotJ" />}}
The '''Starswarm Cluster''' was a dense [[Star cluster/Legends|cluster of stars]] that was located within the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the out-of-luck [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]] attempted to discover a new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] through the Starswarm Cluster. However, the [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] at the core of the densely-packed grouping of [[Star/Legends|stars]] proved to be too damaging to their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Starbreaker 12]]'', and, after barely managing to exit the cluster with their [[Transport/Legends|transport]] intact, the Daragons had to return to Koros Major for much-needed repairs.

==Description==
{{Quote|Hey, it should have worked, but the stars at the core of the cluster were just too dense.|Gav Daragon, on his and his sister Jori's attempt to navigate the Starswarm Cluster|<ref name="TotJ" />}}
The Starswarm Cluster was a [[Star cluster/Legends|cluster of stars]]<ref name="TotJ" /> that was located within the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A dense collection of more than twenty [[Star/Legends|stars]],<ref name="TotJ" /> the cluster was located near the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|We made it!''"<br />"''Just barely. Nobody will pay us for this route&mdash;it's worse than the last one.|Gav and Jori Daragon|<ref name="TotJ" />}}
By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="date">According to the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comics]], the Daragon siblings navigated the Starswarm Cluster shortly before their [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], which is dated to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.</ref> the name of the Starswarm Cluster was already known by the young and out-of-luck [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]]. In that year, the Daragon siblings were forced by their difficult financial situation to try to discover new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] that would be useful for transportation out of the Koros [[Star system/Legends|system]]. To that end, the siblings executed a blind hyperspatial jump from Koros Major in their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Starbreaker 12]]''&mdash;a jump that led them to the direct vicinity of the Starswarm Cluster.<ref name="TotJ" />

Believing that they had found a shortcut and that the [[Hyperspace Navigator's Guild]] would reward them substantially for safe navigation of the star cluster, the young explorers attempted to pass through the densely-packed stars. However, the intense [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] of the stars at the core of the cluster proved to be too much for the starship's systems. With notable effort, the duo managed to exit the Starswarm Cluster with their ship intact, but the ''Starbreaker 12'' had suffered critical damage, and therefore, with the realization that no one would pay them for the new shortcut weighing heavily on them, the Daragon siblings had to return to Koros Major for urgent repairs, using a previously discovered and much longer route. Back on the planet, Gav told his [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] repairman [[Aarrba]] that the stars of the cluster were too dense to safely navigate through.<ref name="TotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The first [[in-universe]] appearance of the Starswarm Cluster was in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 1|first]] issue of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith|''The Golden Age of the Sith'']] story arc of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]].<ref name="TotJ" /> The issue was published on [[October 9]], [[1996]],<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54590/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_golden_age_of_the_sith_1996_1|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Golden Age of the Sith (1996) #1}}</ref> written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]], and penciled by [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]].<ref name="TotJ" /> Later, the star cluster was placed within grid square L-10 by the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA" />
